t: Bosch multi-tool blade set for electrical and drywall applications. Suitable for softwood, hardwood, plasterboard, chipboard, sandwich materials, soft plastics, wood with nails, screws, non-ferrous metal profiles, hardened and unhardened metal, and abrasive materials. Includes a dual-function blade for plunge cuts and corner precision, an Expert carbide blade for long life in metal-embedded wood and abrasive materials, and bi-metal blades in 32mm and 65mm widths for wood and metal. Also features plunge blade with Curved-Tec rounded edges for clean, controlled cutting. Starlock mount enables maximum power transfer and fast blade changes. Compatible with most common multi-tools. Supplied in storage case and colour-coded for easy blade identification.
b: Cuts Wood, Plastic, Fibreglass, Nails, Non-Ferrous Metals, Thin Sheet Metal & Hardened Fillers
